description: Searches the public ConductScience catalog of laboratory equipment and research software by product name, SKU, research keyword or a short description such as "rotarod for mice". Returns matching products with ID, name, SKU, kind (equipment or software), product page URL, image URL, short description, categories, specifications and stock status. Equipment results include the price in US dollars when one is published; price_type is listed, from (a starting price) or request_quote (no published price), and software results use not_applicable. For equipment that published studies name, the result adds one sentence with the number of studies, the date of that count and a link to the list. Returns an empty list when nothing matches.

query.description: Product name, SKU, research keyword or short description

name: search_products
title: Search ConductScience products
